summary.en: The input words appear as plain text beside their weights, their letters spread apart into chips, and a token bar counts in under them, one cell per unit.
summary.zh: 输入的词先以普通文字出现在权重旁，字母散开各自长出字块，下面的词元条一格一格数进来。

fits: The hook of a mechanism explainer: what the input is, as units the run will act on.
notFor: Inputs too long for six rows of chips; inputs that are not sequences of units.

intent.en: The input stops being words and becomes units the run will act on, so the viewer knows what is being counted from the first seconds.
intent.zh: 输入从“词”变成运行要处理的单元，观众开头几秒就知道数的是什么。

content.en: A corpus of 2–6 words with weights (the run), a title (≤ 22 / 8 字), a subtitle (≤ 44 / 14 字), a caption (≤ 40 / 16 字).
content.zh: 2–6 个带权重的词（运行输入），标题（≤ 22 字符 / 8 字），副标题（≤ 44 / 14 字），说明（≤ 40 / 16 字）。

fits.zh: 机制讲解片的钩子：输入是什么，拆成运行要处理的单元。

notFor.zh: 长到六行芯片放不下的输入；不是单元序列的输入。

en: The words stay Latin code in every language; translate the captions, not the corpus.
zh: 词是代码，任何语言都保持拉丁字母；翻译说明，不翻译语料。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
